_meta.ruling: phase3-rulings-2026-07-31.md § 7 — recompute-script class comprehensive, not deferred; census/count primitive tranche first, hard families NAMED

named_families.reason_not_specced: USD figures repriced from token totals at flex rates; needs the pricing block plus per-pass token sums (tranche 2).
Per-pass / per-tile token means, sums and derived shares over cost manifests and pass metas (tranche 2).
usage_stats-vs-per_item_metadata double-count factors; needs a per-axis ratio over every pass meta of a run (tranche 2, audited-flex cost/token runner).
Group-by reductions, distinct-level enumerations and per-condition group sizes within one artefact; beyond count-distinct over a flat list.
min/max/sum reductions spanning more than one artefact, which the single-file aggregate primitive cannot express.
Areas, containment fractions, pairwise point distances, point-in-bounds counts and GeoTIFF ground-sample-distance conversions; needs a geometry stack.
Values only reproducible by re-running an audit/verifier script whose output was never committed.
TP/FP/FN, empty-tile, candidate-flip and candidate-pool set operations recomputed from detection and probability artefacts.
Greps spanning a directory tree (matching files or matching lines across many files); regex-count operates on a single file.
Ranks, top-N memberships and best-of-category selections requiring the board to be re-ordered and its members re-classified.
The quoted span is an interval or non-numeric token, so no scalar comparison is possible whatever the runner returns.
Sweeps over many per-run *.meta.json files (items_processed, unique completed_items, timestamp spans); needs multi-file traversal with per-file reduction.
Wall-clock estimates and numeric constants living in .sh/.py source text; regex-count counts occurrences, it cannot return the constant.
Counts encoded by the ABSENCE of a field or block (single-run evals carrying no n_runs, one-MCC-per-cell, one-tile-per-point); needs a schema assertion, not a count.
Numerals that exist only as JSON object keys or inside label strings; reading them back would be a tautology.
Tile edge lengths that exist only as the pixel dimensions of on-disk PNGs; needs an image reader, which no runner primitive provides.
Tracked-vs-total file counts requiring `git ls-files`; no runner primitive shells out to git.
Counts of comparisons significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction where the artefact stores raw p-values only (tranche 3).
Permutation-test statistics (observed delta, null mean/SD/quantiles, p-values and p-value bounds); needs the permutation machinery on sapphire (tranche 3).
SD / min-max / mean-vs-consensus spread summaries over nested robustness-grid structures (tranche 3).
Bootstrap confidence-interval widths and containment checks (tranche 3).
Derived resolution floors from permutation null_std at a given tile count (tranche 3).
